about_the_game:
The purpose of this "DLC" is to donate to our organiation.

By puchasing, you will receive two things. First, your in-game character mesh will have a gold colored exo suit so others you play with will know you have donated. And secondly, the popup mentioning the Donation DLC will no longer appear when loading the game. (To disable these DLC features, you can uninstall the DLC content by right clicking on the Steam launching shortcut for the game, clicking properties, DLC, and then unchecking the DLC.)


The developer, Metahusk, is a US 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization incorporated under Nonprofit Videogame Development Group, Inc. If you are located in the United States, donations to our organization, like "purchasing" this "DLC"—which grants you in-game cosmetic recognition of your support—is tax-deductable to the extent allowable by law. For tax advice, please consult a tax professional.
